title: BBVA Portugal
meta_description: BBVA Mobile, a new way to have your bank always at hand.
full_description: BBVA Mobile App, to access your bank and manage your day to day from your mobile phone.With the BBVA Mobile app, you carry out your day-to-day operations in a fast, convenient and very safe way, wherever you are and whenever you need it:• Balances and Movements Queries: check the position of all your products in BBVA;• Transfers: make your transfers on time or schedule for the date you want;• Payments: you can make your payments for services, the state and social security;• Charges: you can charge your mobile phone, via green, among others;• Activation and Cancellation of Cards: Activate and / or cancel your debit and credit cards whenever you need them.All this without having to go to the Bank.Change the time to go to the bank by time for yourself.
